name: Hook Overview
subtitle: Traffic signals, failures and telemetry freshness

queries.totals: SELECT toInt32(count()) AS events,toInt32(uniqExact(source)) AS sources,toInt32(countIf(outcome='failed')) AS failures,quantileExact(0.95)(lag_ms) AS lag_ms FROM (SELECT record.event.event_id::String AS event_id, any(record.recorded_at_ms::Float64) AS at_ms, any(record.event.source::String) AS source, any(record.event.step::String) AS event, any(record.event.outcome::String) AS outcome, any(record.event.operation::String) AS operation, any(record.event.route::String) AS route, any(record.event.method::String) AS method, any(record.event.status::Nullable(Int32)) AS status, any(record.event.duration_ms::Nullable(Float64)) AS latency_ms, any(record.event.progress::Nullable(Int32)) AS progress, any(record.event.version::String) AS version, any(record.event.trace_id::String) AS request_id, greatest(0., toFloat64(min(registered_ts_ms)) - at_ms) AS lag_ms FROM siliconhook WHERE record.service::String = 'silicon-hook' AND record.environment_id::String = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND record.recorded_at_ms::Float64 >= toUnixTimestamp64Milli(now64()) - 86400000 AND record.event.event_id::String != '' AND record.event.step::String != 'verification' GROUP BY event_id)
